title: Beyond Language Modeling: An Exploration of Multimodal Pretraining
author: Shengbang Tong, David Fan, John Nguyen, Ellis Brown, Boyang Zheng, Théophane Vallaeys, Rob Fergus, Naila Murray, Marjan Ghazvininejad, Mike Lewis, Nicolas Ballas, Jakob Verbeek, Luke Zettlemoyer, Koustuv Sinha, Yann LeCun, Saining Xie
summary: This paper studies how to build models that understand both images and language together from scratch. It finds that combining visual and language data helps models learn better and that vision needs more data than language. The authors show that a special model design called Mixture-of-Experts can handle these differences and improve multimodal learning.
